visual.description: Primary white background used across content sections throughout the page.
Primary black used for the large display logo, section headings, and navigation links.
Black used for all body copy, news article titles, dates, and informational text.
Navigation link text color in the transparent/overlay state at top of page.
Navigation link color in the transparent hero overlay state.
Navigation text remains black after scroll — no color change on scroll detected.
Muted sage green side panel background visible on both left and right edges throughout the page.
Off-white/cream color used as the background for the bottom utility bar (newsletter sign-up bar) and the rotated sidebar text.
Light cream used on the rotated vertical sidebar labels (SIMON ROGAN, RESERVATION) as text/button background.
Vibrant chrome yellow used as the dominant footer background — the brand's signature accent color.
Brand yellow also appears as the footer section background, signaling the primary brand color.
Near-black text used for contact details, navigation links, and legal copy within the yellow footer.
Deep sage green of the side rail panels flanking the hero and all content sections — a structural brand color.
Warm greige/light taupe used as the thin horizontal rule separating the newsletter bar from the news section.
Dark charcoal used for secondary body text and article dates in the news listing section.
The sidebar/utility bar cream off-white that persists as the nav scrolls — consistent with the sticky bottom bar color.
Dark grey used for the circular arrow pagination button border and icon in the news section.
